map.lumbridge.desc: Farm animals, goblins and the undead of Draynor Manor. Count Draynor wakes halfway, and the Wise Old Man comes at the end.

map.lumbridge.victory: The Wise Old Man is defeated!
map.barrows.name: Barrows
map.barrows.desc: Crypt rats, spiders and bloodworms, ghouls, Mort'ton's afflicted and shades, and feral vampyres. The six Barrows brothers climb out of their crypts one by one, every two and a half minutes. Dharok comes last.
map.barrows.warning: The last brother stirs in his crypt...
map.barrows.victory: The Barrows brothers are laid to rest!
map.wilderness.name: Wilderness
map.wilderness.desc: Revenants, bandits, dark warriors and chaos druids, the undead of the Graveyard of Shadows, hill giants and the Ankou. The Crazy archaeologist and the Chaos Fanatic, and the King Black Dragon at the end.
map.wilderness.warning: Something huge stirs beneath the Lava Maze...
map.wilderness.victory: The King Black Dragon is slain!
map.desert.name: Kharidian Desert
map.desert.desc: Lizards, scorpions and jackals, desert bandits, kalphites out of their hive, crocodiles, mummies and locust riders. Desert Treasure's Fareed, Dessous and Damis come one by one, and the Kalphite Queen at the end.
map.desert.warning: The sand trembles beneath your feet...
map.fremennik.name: Fremennik Province
map.fremennik.desc: Rock crabs and wolves, cockatrices and yaks, trolls, basilisks and jellies, dagannoths and wallasalki, kurasks and rock lobsters. The three Dagannoth Kings come one by one, and Vorkath at the end.
map.fremennik.warning: Something stirs in the ice of Ungael...
map.karamja.name: Karamja
map.karamja.desc: Monkeys, snakes and jungle spiders, tribesmen, jogres and moss giants, lesser demons, and the TzHaar up out of the volcano. Elvarg, Nezikchened and Ket-Zek come one by one, and TzTok-Jad at the end.
map.karamja.warning: The volcano rumbles... TzTok-Jad is coming!
map.kourend.name: Kourend
map.kourend.desc: Guanic bats, swamp crabs and lizards, lizardmen and their brutes, bloodvelds, Xeric's deathly rangers, mages and skeletal mystics, and hydras. The Lizardman shaman, Sarachnis and Skotizo come one by one, and the Alchemical Hydra at the end.
map.varlamore.name: Varlamore
map.varlamore.desc: Jerboas, pyre foxes and antelopes, blood jaguars, serpent shamans and jaguar warriors, naguas, the Fremennik warband, gryphons and minotaurs. The Manticore and the Shockwave and Javelin Colossi come one by one, and Sol Heredit at the end.
map.varlamore.warning: The crowd roars... Sol Heredit enters the arena!
map.morytania.name: Morytania
map.morytania.desc: Ghasts, shades and zombies out of Mort Myre, vampyre juveniles and juvinates, werewolves, nail beasts and mutated bloodvelds, the Theatre of Blood's Nylocas and Darkmeyer's vyrewatch. Vanstrom Klause, the Pestilent Bloat and Sotetseg come one by one, and Verzik Vitur at the end.
map.morytania.warning: The Theatre's curtain rises... Verzik Vitur awaits!
map.god_wars.name: God Wars Dungeon
map.god_wars.desc: The armies of Bandos, Armadyl, Saradomin and Zamorak, at war with each other as much as with you: goblins, orks and cyclopes, aviansies, knights and priests, imps, hellhounds and bloodvelds, and the gods' spiritual warriors. Commander Zilyana, Kree'arra and K'ril Tsutsaroth come one by one, General Graardor leads a charge, and Nex comes at the end.
map.god_wars.warning: The frozen door cracks... Nex is breaking free!
map.prifddinas.name: Prifddinas
map.prifddinas.desc: The Gauntlet's crystalline rats, bats, spiders, scorpions, wolves, bears and dark beasts, the city's guards, the Iorwerth's warriors and archers and Zulrah's snakelings, and the corrupted ones late on. Zulrah, Zalcano and the Crystalline Hunllef come one by one, and the Corrupted Hunllef at the end.
map.prifddinas.warning: The crystal singing turns sour... the Corrupted Hunllef is coming!
map.inferno.name: The Inferno
map.inferno.desc: Mor Ul Rek's TzHaar and the Inferno's creatures: nibblers, Jal-MejRah bats, Jal-Ak blobs that split, Jal-ImKot that dig up near you, Jal-Xil, and Jal-Zek that raise the dead. JalTok-Jad, a Jal-Zek champion and a TzHaar-Ket champion come one by one, and three JalTok-Jads at once at the end.
map.inferno.warning: The lava churns... three JalTok-Jads are rising!
map.inferno.victory: The JalTok-Jads are slain! You are the champion of the Inferno!
map.halloween.name: Hallowed Night
map.halloween.desc: A graveyard hamlet in a pumpkin patch, on the one night its dead won't lie still. Slash Bash and The Mimic come one by one, and The Nightmare rises at the end.
map.halloween.warning: The pumpkins go dark... The Nightmare is waking!
map.halloween.victory: The Nightmare is laid to rest!
map.phosani.name: Phosani's Nightmare
map.phosani.desc: The Nightmare's hard mode, on its own: her dream, walled round in the stone of the Sisterhood Sanctuary beneath Slepe. No waves, no picks and no items: the Armadyl crossbow, and her. She rises as you arrive, quicker than before and with more at once, and every hit of hers is shown before it lands. Her totems' blasts are the only rest, and each heals you.
map.phosani.victory: Phosani's Nightmare is laid to rest!
map.zachariah.name: Justiciar Zachariah
map.zachariah.desc: The Justiciar of the Owl puts you on trial in his court, hung in the Hallowed Sepulchre's dark. No waves, no picks and no items: Saradomin Strike, which reaches him only from close by, and him. His court is his weapon: read its statues, its floor and its fire, and stay near enough to strike.
map.zachariah.victory: The Owl's judgement is passed: Justiciar Zachariah yields!
map.beneath_cursed_sands.name: Beneath Cursed Sands
map.beneath_cursed_sands.desc: A quest, as a boss fight in four parts, each kept once it's won: Coenus the Head Menaphite Guard, the Scarab Mages, the Champion of Scabaras and the Menaphite Akh, in a tomb beneath the desert. Done, it opens the Tombs of Amascut.
map.beneath_cursed_sands.victory: The Menaphite Akh is slain! The Tombs of Amascut are open to you.
map.theatre_of_blood.name: Theatre of Blood
map.theatre_of_blood.desc:
**A melee raid in six rooms.** Survive each room's waves on the way through Morytania, then kill its boss to move on: the Maiden, the Bloat, Nylocas Vasilias, Sotetseg, Xarpus, then Verzik in Vampyrium.

**Bosses pray against missiles and magic**, which do only 15% of their damage to them, and there's nowhere safe by them: up close they stomp, bite and burst.

**Raid points** come from fast, clean rooms. They pay coins, buy supplies between rooms, and raise your chance of a purple at the end.

**Weapons come from the chest**, not for clearing: a Ghrazi rapier from it unlocks the rapier, a chance each clear. On hard or expert it can also hold the Holy Scythe of Vitur, which unlocks the Holy Scythe.

**Portals:** once you've killed a room's boss, its hall has a portal straight to it (three a raid).

**Hard mode** opens when you beat the raid.

**Expert mode** opens when you beat it on hard. It's hard mode with more of the real raid's mechanics: the Nylocas only take their own style, the Maiden's Nylocas heal her, Xarpus stares, and Verzik's ball must be hidden from. Twice the coins, and a Lil' Zik look each clear.
map.theatre_of_blood.warning: The Theatre's curtain rises... Verzik Vitur awaits!
map.theatre_of_blood.victory: The Theatre of Blood is complete!
map.tombs_of_amascut.name: Tombs of Amascut
map.tombs_of_amascut.desc: Amascut's tomb beneath the desert: four paths from the Nexus, each a puzzle and its guardian, in any order, then the Wardens. The invocations set the raid level, and the chest pays out by it.
map.grand_exchange.name: Grand Exchange
map.grand_exchange.desc: Spam bots, scammers, lurers, gold farmers, fake moderators and merchants. The Doubler, the Lure master and the Bot farmer turn up at random. Endless.
map.east_varrock.name: East Varrock
map.east_varrock.desc: The Wilderness, just past the ditch: free-to-play pkers in multi, clan noobs, rangers, mages, pures and tanks, in nothing members get, and more jumping the ditch behind you. A Clan leader, a Rune 2h pure and a Wildy mage turn up at random. Endless.
map.falador.name: Falador
map.falador.desc: 6 June 2006, world 111. You're Durial321, a house party has gone wrong, and all of Falador wants to be killed. A Player moderator, Cursed You and Mod Murdoch turn up at random. Endless.
fun.falador.chat.5: greatest day of my RS life!!!
map.last_man_standing.name: Last Man Standing
map.last_man_standing.desc: The Desert Island, and everyone else on it in LMS loadouts and chest loot. An AGS specer, a Claws specer and a Dharok's sweat turn up at random. No fog. Endless.
map.castle_wars.name: Castle Wars
map.castle_wars.desc: Mid-game in the arena: the Zamorak team in hooded cloaks and decorative armour, and the Saradomin team, who hate them even more than they hate you. A Flag carrier (two caskets, if you can catch him), a Catapult crew and a Zamorak tank turn up at random. Endless.
map.pest_control.name: Pest Control
map.pest_control.desc: The Void Knight's island, overrun: brawlers, ravagers, splatters that go off when they die, shifters that teleport to you, and spinners that heal the portals. All four portals open every few minutes, shielded at first; destroy them all for a master casket. Endless.
fun.pest_control.together: All four portals are destroyed! The Void Knight leaves you a master casket.

pumpkin.1.message: Treat! The pumpkin is stuffed with coins.
pumpkin.2.message: Treat! A sugar rush: faster and stronger for 15 seconds.
pumpkin.3.message: Trick! Ghosts burst out of the pumpkin!
pumpkin.4.message: Trick! The pumpkin curses you: slower for 6 seconds.
floor.wardens.script.6.message: The floor crumbles away behind you!
floor.wardens.script.34.message: The floor knits itself back together.
event.mysterious_old_man.name: Mysterious Old Man
event.mysterious_old_man.arrive: A mysterious old man appears nearby.
event.mysterious_old_man.leave: The old man shrugs and wanders off.
event.mysterious_old_man.speech: I've got a few things that fell off the back of a cart. Interested?
event.quiz_master.name: Quiz Master
event.quiz_master.leave: The Quiz Master goes looking for a brighter contestant.
event.quiz_master.speech: Three of these go together. Which is the odd one out?
event.quiz_master.shout.2: Who wants to win a prize?
event.quiz_master.wrong: Oh, bad luck! Better luck next time.
event.genie.name: Genie
event.genie.leave: The genie grows tired of waiting and vanishes.
event.genie.message: The genie grants you some experience!
event.sandwich_lady.name: Sandwich lady
event.sandwich_lady.leave: How rude! The sandwich lady throws a baguette at you.
event.sandwich_lady.shout.2: Hello? I made you a baguette!
event.sandwich_lady.message: The sandwich lady hands you a baguette. Delicious!
event.rick_turpentine.name: Rick Turpentine
event.rick_turpentine.leave: Rick Turpentine tips his hat and rides off.
event.rick_turpentine.shout.1: A gift, from one rogue to another!
event.rick_turpentine.message: Rick Turpentine drops a casket at your feet!
event.strange_plant.name: Strange plant
event.strange_plant.arrive: A strange plant grows up nearby.
event.strange_plant.message: You eat a strange fruit: +30% movement speed, and poison can't touch you.
event.highwayman.name: Highwayman
event.raid_supplies.name: Supply chest
event.raid_supplies.speech: Spend your raid points on supplies for the next room.
